name: 石肤蜥
evolution: 石肤蜥 → 石刺蜥 Lv.32 → 石冠王蜥 Lv.48
description: 常在半山腰处被发现，独立生活，会收集细小的石头筑巢。背上的石头是体内生长出来的一种分泌物，喜欢钻到石头堆里蹭背，可以把背上的石头打磨得更锋利。
descriptionEn: Often found halfway up mountainsides, it lives alone and gathers small stones to build a nest. The stones on its back are a secretion grown from inside its body; it likes to burrow into piles of stones and rub its back, which grinds the stones on its back sharper.

skills.name: 泥巴喷射
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 石肤术
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +160% physical defense and -60% magic defense.

skills.name: 钧势
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +140% physical defense and Speed -30.

skills.description: 减伤90%，若上次使用攻击技则本技能能耗-2，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 90%; if an attack skill was used last time, this skill's energy cost -2; counters attacks.

skills.name: 陨石

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy is immobilized for 3 turns.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; at the end of the turn, this skill's energy cost is permanently -1.

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time it is attacked once, this skill's energy cost is permanently -1.

skills.name: 地陷
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得物防+70%，应对状态：本次技能威力翻倍，且物防额外+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, self gains +70% physical defense; against Status: this skill's power doubles, and physical defense gains an additional +70%.

skills.name: 刺盾

skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks: the enemy gets -70% physical attack.
